root.help:
usage: bo-forge [-h] [--version]
                {doctor,init-log,validate,summary,status,next-action,cost-summary,replicate-summary,stage-summary,fidelity-summary,fidelity-coverage,context-summary,qlog-nei-summary,model-summary,model-compare,pareto-front,pareto-summary,report,model-evaluate,provenance,provenance-recover,provenance-adopt,provenance-migrate,provenance-accept-config,provenance-fork,suggest,review,mark-observed,plot}
                ...

Run BO Forge campaign workflows from the terminal.

positional arguments:
  {doctor,init-log,validate,summary,status,next-action,cost-summary,replicate-summary,stage-summary,fidelity-summary,fidelity-coverage,context-summary,qlog-nei-summary,model-summary,model-compare,pareto-front,pareto-summary,report,model-evaluate,provenance,provenance-recover,provenance-adopt,provenance-migrate,provenance-accept-config,provenance-fork,suggest,review,mark-observed,plot}
    doctor              Check the active BO Forge environment.
    init-log            Create an empty canonical campaign CSV log and
                        provenance manifest.
    validate            Validate a campaign CSV log.
    summary             Print campaign summary.
    status              Print campaign status.
    next-action         Print the recommended next campaign action.
    cost-summary        Print campaign cost and budget summary.
    replicate-summary   Print observed replicate-group summary statistics.
    stage-summary       Print structured-campaign stage summary fields.
    fidelity-summary    Print multi-fidelity campaign summary fields.
    fidelity-coverage   Print observed and active-suggestion coverage by
                        fidelity value.
    context-summary     Print contextual-campaign summary rows by context
                        combination.
    qlog-nei-summary    Print qLogNEI pending-state summary fields.
    model-summary       Print model profile and fitting-input summary fields.
    model-compare       Compare model profiles on current observed fitting
                        rows.
    pareto-front        Print nondominated observed rows for a multi-objective
                        campaign.
    pareto-summary      Print Pareto-front and hypervolume summary fields.
    report              Print or export a campaign report.
    model-evaluate      Evaluate model profiles using held-out predictions.
    provenance          Print campaign provenance and integrity fields.
    provenance-recover  Explicitly resolve an interrupted managed-campaign
                        transaction.
    provenance-adopt    Preview or explicitly apply provenance adopt.
    provenance-migrate  Preview or explicitly apply provenance migrate.
    provenance-accept-config
                        Preview or explicitly apply provenance accept-config.
    provenance-fork     Preview or explicitly apply provenance fork.
    suggest             Generate campaign suggestions.
    review              Accept, reject, or defer one suggested row.
    mark-observed       Mark one pending suggestion as observed.
    plot                Export one campaign plot.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
